name: WorkOS
summary: WorkOS gives software companies APIs for enterprise features such as single sign-on, directory sync, permissions, audit logs, and user management.
overview: WorkOS sells developer infrastructure for adding enterprise-grade authentication, provisioning, permissions, and compliance features to software products.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: WorkOS announced the Series C and its $2B valuation.

bull_case: The growth of AI-native software increases the number of products that need enterprise security and identity capabilities quickly, expanding WorkOS's potential customer base.
bear_case: Identity and authorization are crowded categories, and larger platform vendors or in-house engineering can limit pricing power.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: WorkOS provides developer APIs for enterprise authentication, provisioning, permissions, and compliance features.
company: WorkOS helps software companies meet enterprise requirements without building every identity and administrative feature themselves. Its products include SSO, directory synchronization, user management, RBAC, audit logs, and related developer tooling.

In March 2026, WorkOS announced a $100 million Series C led by Meritech and Sapphire at a $2 billion valuation. The company says it serves thousands of customers and processes billions of API requests each month.
intelligence.why_it_matters: WorkOS is a useful indicator of the enterprise-readiness layer behind the AI-software boom. More applications need authentication, authorization, and auditability before large organizations will adopt them.

changed.text: Profile reviewed against available public information.

takeaways: WorkOS turns enterprise identity and compliance requirements into developer APIs.
It raised $100 million in a March 2026 Series C at a $2 billion valuation.
AI-native applications are a growing source of demand for enterprise-ready infrastructure.
The key question is whether WorkOS expands from a focused identity layer into a broader platform.
